# SourceKart India

> The Source You Trust. The Quality You Need.

SourceKart India is a sourcing and distribution company focused on high-quality nutraceutical, food and health ingredients. We connect manufacturers with reliable sources for amino acids, vitamins, minerals, proteins, sweeteners, extracts and other specialty ingredients. With a focus on quality, competitive sourcing and dependable supply, we make procurement simpler for businesses across the industry.

- Established: 2026
- Founder: Jainam Bagadia
- Type: Food & health ingredient sourcing and distribution
- Contact: info@sourcekart.in | WhatsApp https://wa.me/919324262269

## Core facts

- 8 product categories: Vitamins, Amino Acids, Herbal Extracts, Nutraceuticals, Sweeteners, Nucleotides, Proteins, Sports Nutrition
- 4 primary industries: Pharmaceuticals, Nutraceuticals, Animal Nutrition, Sports Nutrition
- GST: 27GFSPB5688J1ZL
- Every lot ships with COA, with Halal and Kosher documentation across the portfolio
- Supply approach: Source → Verify → Supply
- Promise: Right Source. Right Ingredient. Right Supply.

## Product categories

- [Vitamins](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/vitamins): Biotin, Calcium D Pantothenate (B5), Inositol (B8), Vitamin A Acetate/Palmitate, D2, D3, E 50%, K1
- [Amino Acids](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/amino-acids): Glycine, L Alanine, L Arginine, L Carnitine, L Cysteine, L Glutamic Acid, L Lysine, L Methionine, L Theanine, and more (40+ items)
- [Herbal Extracts](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/herbal-extracts): 5-HTP, Ginseng Extract, Grape Seed Extract, Quercetin, Resveratrol, Rutin, Silymarin 80%
- [Nutraceuticals](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/nutraceuticals): Coenzyme Q10, Creatine variants, GABA, Glutathione, Melatonin, MSM, SAMe, Sodium Hyaluronate, and more
- [Sweeteners](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/sweeteners): Acesulfame K, Allulose, Aspartame, Erythritol, Mannitol, Sucralose, Trehalose, Xylitol, and more
- [Nucleotides](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/nucleotides): NMN, NR Chloride, NAD, and other NAD+ precursors
- [Proteins](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/proteins): Pea Protein, Soy Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Whey Protein 80% Instant
- [Sports Nutrition](https://www.sourcekartindia.com/products/sports-nutrition): BCAA, Beta Alanine, Betaine Anhydrous, Creatine Monohydrate, EAA

## Process

1. Enquiry & Specification (Day 0)
2. Sourcing & Quotation (Day 1-2)
3. Quality Assurance (Day 2-3)
4. Dispatch & Logistics (Day 3-5)
5. After-Sales Support (Ongoing)
